POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL initialization user, or the matching connection user for the private database.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial PostgreSQL database name, or the matching database selected by the application.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password. Generated for the database and referenced by dependent services; keep private.

PGDATA.description: PostgreSQL data directory within the persistent volume. Do not change on an existing database.

SETUP_DATABASE_HOST.description: Copy this private hostname into the protected PostgreSQL installer. This is an operator reference, not an automatic farmOS setting.

SETUP_DATABASE_PORT.description: Use this PostgreSQL port in the installer.

SETUP_DATABASE_NAME.description: Use this existing database name in the installer.

SETUP_DATABASE_USER.description: Use this database user in the installer.

SETUP_DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: Copy this generated password into the installer. Preserve it with the database backup.

TZ.description: Tz for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for farmos. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Owner auth for farmos. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_SCOPE.description: Owner scope for farmos. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
